V14_SYSTEM_ID=$(docker exec -e PGPASSWORD=stock "$V14_CONTAINER" psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U stock -d v14_test -Atc \

steps.name: M17.1.1 and M17.1.2 exact HEAD and migration receipts
steps.run:
python - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import subprocess
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from pathlib import Path
from alembic.config import Config
from alembic.script import ScriptDirectory
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text

head = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
assert head == os.environ["GITHUB_SHA"], "CI_HEAD_MISMATCH"
engine = create_engine(os.environ["DATABASE_URL"])
try:
    with engine.connect() as connection:
        current = connection.scalar(text("SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version"))
        pg_version = connection.scalar(text("SHOW server_version_num"))
        timing_column = dict(connection.execute(text(
            "SELECT data_type, character_maximum_length, is_nullable "
            "FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' "
            "AND table_name='stock_suspend_daily' AND column_name='suspend_timing'"
        )).mappings().one())
finally:
    engine.dispose()
heads = ScriptDirectory.from_config(Config("alembic.ini")).get_heads()
assert heads == [current] == ["0058_data_publication"], "CI_MIGRATION_HEAD_MISMATCH"
assert pg_version.startswith("17"), "CI_POSTGRES_MAJOR_MISMATCH"
assert timing_column == {
    "data_type": "text", "character_maximum_length": None, "is_nullable": "YES",
}, "CI_SUSPEND_TIMING_SCHEMA_MISMATCH"
run_url = (f"https://github.com/{os.environ['GITHUB_REPOSITORY']}/actions/runs/"
           f"{os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID']}")
receipt = {
    "schema_version": "m17.1.1-ci-receipt-v1", "head_sha": head,
    "run_url": run_url, "alembic_current": current, "alembic_heads": heads,
    "postgres_version_num": pg_version,
    "created_at": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "scope": "All preceding blocking steps passed; final Actions conclusion is authoritative",
}
output = Path(".codex_tmp/m17_1_1-release.json")
output.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
output.write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
suspend_receipt = {
    **receipt, "schema_version": "m17.1.2-ci-receipt-v1",
    "suspend_timing_column": timing_column,
    "targeted_junit": "m17_1_2-targeted.xml",
    "full_junit": "m17_1_2-full.xml",
    "production_validation": "PENDING_APPROVAL", "production_job_id": None,
}
Path(".codex_tmp/m17_1_2-release.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(suspend_receipt, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8",
)
with open(os.environ["GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"], "a", encoding="utf-8") as stream:
    stream.write(f"## M17.1.1\n\nHEAD: `{head}`\n\nCI: {run_url}\n\n"
                 f"Alembic current=heads: `{current}`\n")
    stream.write(f"\n## M17.1.2\n\nHEAD: `{head}`\n\nCI: {run_url}\n\n"
                 "suspend_timing: nullable TEXT; G1 real backfill pending approval.\n")
PY
